mensagens.input: Heather and Dave each received a small pie to enjoy. Heather likes to cut her pie into 4 pieces, and Dave likes to cut his pie into 8 pieces. After enjoying their snack, Heather and Dave compared their pie to see who has eaten less.
Heather has eaten 3/4 of her pie.
Dave has eaten 6/8 of his pie.
-----,Heather has eaten less of her pie.,Dave has eaten less of his pie.,Both have eaten the same amount of their pies.
Who has eaten less of their pie?
